subject: Hosted API capacity + pricing follow-up
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lim <sara.lim@acmehr.com>, Diego Morales <diego@acmehr.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: Hosted API discovery — quick recap and asks

Hi Sara / Diego — thanks again for the call this morning. Short recap and explicit asks so we can size a hosted pricing path that fits Acme HR.

Summary of what I heard on the call:
- Primary use case: automated offer-letter + onboarding content generation and candidate Q&A (session chat + multi-turn).
- Estimated average tokens per interaction: ~650–900 (current average ~800).
- Expected ramp: Month 1 pilot ~30M tokens / month, Month 6 target ~140–170M tokens / month (growth driven by new teams).
- Burst profile: normal sustained TPS 20–50; short bursts up to ~200–250 TPS for 30–120s when batch onboarding events happen.
- Target budget guidance you mentioned: aiming for roughly $30–$45 per 1M generation tokens (team target, flexible).

Concrete asks (can you confirm):
1) Confirm the conservative monthly token range for next 3 months (pick low/expected/high).
2) Confirm expected peak burst size and typical burst duration (we need to verify capacity + autoscale design).
3) Any specific latency SLO requirement at 95th percentile? (e.g., <=300ms for single-turn, <=600ms ok for multi-turn).

Next steps from my side: I can send a short preliminary quote with a couple of pricing options (hosted metered vs. committed-tier discount) and a suggested MAP for a 6-week pilot. Attaching a short MAP + quick-quote spreadsheet.

Thanks — Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0193

From: Diego Morales <diego@acmehr.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Sara Lim <sara.lim@acmehr.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T11:07:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API discovery — quick recap and asks

Thanks Rishi — useful summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Monthly token trajectory (conservative / expected / upside):
   - Conservative (pilot): 25M–35M / month
   - Expected (production after 3–4 months): 110M–150M / month
   - Upside (full adoption across HR + Talent): 250M+ / month

2) Peak characteristics: we see baseline ~30–40 TPS. Planned calendar-driven bursts (e.g., open enrollment, new grad onboarding) can push 200–300 TPS for short windows (30s–3m). Rarely sustained >60 TPS for more than 15 minutes.

3) Latency: for candidate-facing flows we want <=500ms P95 for single-turn generation; <=800ms P95 tolerable for multi-turn.

Budget: our procurement lead mentioned target $/1M tokens of ~$35 (we're flexible if tradeoffs on latency / SLA / caching are clear).

Please include both metered hosted pricing and a 6/12-month committed tier in the quote. Also can you include any onboarding credits / trial limits for initial integration?

Diego
Director, Product — Acme HR

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lim <sara.lim@acmehr.com>, Diego Morales <diego@acmehr.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T08:45:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API discovery — preliminary quote & MAP attached

Appreciate the details Diego — attached is the quick-quote workbook and a one-page Mutual Action Plan (MAP). High-level price guidance and unit-econ assumptions are below so you can sanity-check quickly before we formalize in the quote.

Assumptions we used (please flag if any are off):
- Avg tokens / API call: 800
- Calls per user session: 1.2 (mix of single-turn + short multi-turn)
- Effective monthly tokens (expected): 130M (midpoint of your expected range)
- Peak TPS to design for: 250 TPS burst capacity; sustained scaling to 60 TPS without degradation

Two hosted pricing paths (ballpark) — final numbers deferring to finance for legal quote:
1) Metered hosted (no commitment): $45 / 1M tokens
   - Good for pilot and unpredictable volume; no minimums; includes baseline caching and 30 days of observability retention.
2) Committed volume (12-month, tiered discounts): $28–$34 / 1M tokens depending on committed monthly volume, and deeper discounts if you add a 6–12 week onboarding package and a 12-month commit.

Estimated monthly cost examples (generation tokens only):
- Pilot (30M / mo @ $45): ~$1,350 per month
- Expected (130M / mo @ $34): ~$4,420 per month
- Upside (250M / mo @ $28): ~$7,000 per month

Unit-econ note: these prices are generation-token-only. If you use embeddings or higher-context models there are different per-1M rates; we included those lines in the spreadsheet. We can also show the effect of prefix/KV caching vs. raw tokens to outline realized spend.

Recommended next steps:
- Diego / Sara: confirm which of the three monthly-volume scenarios (conservative / expected / upside) you want us to model formally in the quote.
- Acme: confirm willingness to consider a 6–12 month committed tier (says yes/no) so we can propose the discount schedule.
- Redwood: Vanessa to provision trial keys (100k tokens/day) and open a test project; engineering onboarding call to be scheduled week of Aug 24.

I've attached: 1) 20260815_acme_mapp_quick_quote.xlsx 2) 20260815_acme_map.pdf

--
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T09:02:00-04:00
Subject: Internal: enable trial + ENG onboarding

Rishi — noted. I will: 
- Create the test Project and issue API keys with 100k tokens/day trial limit (expiration 30 days).
- Loop in Solutions Eng (separately) to confirm 250 TPS burst readiness and P95 targets (500ms / 800ms thresholds Diego requested).
- Add a line in the quote to show residual cost after KV caching (conservative 12% token reduction).

I'll update the MAP with milestones (integration test, security review, pilot success metrics) and drop in HubSpot. ETA: I will push keys + update HubSpot entry by EOD.

Vanessa
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Sara Lim <sara.lim@acmehr.com>

Subject: Re: Hosted API discovery — preliminary quote & MAP attached

Thanks Rishi — numbers look reasonable. We are comfortable modeling expected (130M/mo) and pilot (30M/mo). Diego and I will discuss committed-term tradeoffs with procurement — target $/1M ~ $35 still our anchor.

Confirming the following now:
- Pilot start: week of Aug 31
- Integration call: please schedule Solutions Eng for Aug 24–26 window
- Security: we'll start the standard vendor security questionnaire after the MAP sign-off

We reviewed the attachments and will follow up with any detailed redlines. Please send the HubSpot deal link and the DocuSign NDA when ready.

Sara
